mostWorthwhile.text: The B-cell division into plasma and memory cells was most worthwhile: the branching sequence connected one matching cell to both chapter goals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the messenger cell at the lymph node before combining it with bacteria felt out of order; the later picture had to clarify that it collected material in the airway first.

surprise.text: The B cell displayed a bacterial fragment after binding the intact protein, which helped explain its later interaction with a helper T cell.

arbitrary.text: The messenger-cell placement felt mechanically arbitrary because the preparation preceded the depicted collection and journey.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it explored a new interaction as clearly as the B-cell response. Several placement steps felt routine, so my interest would depend on what came next.
